description: This file is an HTML document that contains embedded JavaScript code implementing a StringStream class used for syntax highlighting in CodeMirror's JavaScript mode. It also includes references to external scripts and stylesheets related to the CodeMirror editor and its features.

classes.name: StringStream
classes.description: A class that provides methods for tokenizing and processing a string input, used for syntax highlighting.

methods.name: StringStream.prototype.done
methods.description: Checks if the end of the string has been reached.

methods.name: StringStream.prototype.peek
methods.description: Returns the current character without advancing the position.

methods.name: StringStream.prototype.next
methods.description: Returns the current character and advances the position by one.

methods.name: StringStream.prototype.eat
methods.description: Consumes the current character if it matches the provided pattern.

methods.name: StringStream.prototype.eatWhile
methods.description: Consumes characters while they match the given pattern.

methods.name: StringStream.prototype.backUp
methods.description: Moves the position backward by n characters.

methods.name: StringStream.prototype.column
methods.description: Returns the current position in the string.

methods.name: StringStream.prototype.match
methods.description: Attempts to match a pattern at the current position, optionally consuming it.
